scope: Allow only the anonymous page browser to send its ordinary GET /_bm/get_params with fixed type=get-akid and one bounded browser-generated v value. No token derivation, challenge solving, login, proxy/IP change, spoofing or origin-block retry. Unknown methods/paths and origin blocks still stop. This is a local manifest review, not a reset of an origin denial.
source_evidence: First-party script execution on the approved entry page generated this path; request was intercepted before transmission. Exact current first-party script bodies are retained in cycle cache.
